caption:
History ready. What happens next?

A complete window does not make every product immediately show a prior price. The relevant reduction needs a full recorded history before it.

If a price was reduced while history was still building, the app cannot invent the missing earlier days. A later eligible reduction can show the observed prior price.

India Prior Price keeps the display hidden when its conditions are not met. Coming soon. Follow for launch.
